evidence.title: agenttik README
evidence.locator: Main features, Quick start, Remote servers, Desktop builds, License
evidence.finding: Local workspace running Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot through official CLIs (OpenCode Go implemented) in a desktop window or browser; project workspaces, orchestrator project, live sessions with queues, pinned prompts and recurring schedules, model and permission controls, file editing, git diffs, staging and commits, usage tracking, SQLite history; remote connections; loopback by default; MIT.

evidence.title: Spec 030: Tasks on the project page
evidence.finding: A project has Tasks, Jobs, Prompt and Stats panes; open tasks in dragged order with paging, fuzzy and smart search, and archive pages.

evidence.title: Spec 012: The task queue
evidence.finding: Queued prompts persist and run per project after active turns finish.

evidence.title: Spec 028: Scheduled jobs
evidence.finding: A prompt can recur; each due run creates a new task on the saved provider, model, effort, permission and mode, queued behind active turns.

evidence.title: Spec 054: Orchestrator project
evidence.finding: An app-wide orchestrator project, on by default, coordinates work across projects using the same task, schedule, file and provider machinery.

evidence.title: Orchestrator default instructions
evidence.finding: Orchestrator agent uses the agenttik command with --api to list projects and tasks, create tasks, send or queue prompts, stop, archive, rename, manage schedules and take screenshots.

evidence.title: Spec 082: Tool approvals and questions
evidence.finding: Permission mode settles most tool calls; destructive commands or connector tools needing approval are asked mid-turn; agents ask questions with options; Claude Code and Codex ask, others do not yet.

evidence.title: Spec 064: Remote connections
evidence.finding: agenttik --remote host:port opens a desktop client for another agenttik server without running local providers.

evidence.title: Spec 043: Exposed server
evidence.finding: Settings › Server can expose the backend to browsers on other machines, off by default, with optional login.

evidence.title: Spec 084: Quick tunnel
evidence.finding: Public internet address through a built-in Cloudflare Quick Tunnel client, no account needed.

evidence.title: Spec 099: Mobile app
evidence.finding: Capacitor 8 app for Android and iOS that finds or takes a server address, signs in, then shows that server's web UI.

evidence.title: Spec 074: Task attention
evidence.finding: Unread finished turns show amber dots; failed tasks keep red dots; running tasks pulse.

evidence.title: Spec 011: Prompt-bar usage indicators
evidence.finding: Context usage ring and subscription allowance bars with session totals.

evidence.title: store/analytics.go
evidence.finding: Local analytics aggregate turns per task and subscription by model and effort; no network reporting.

evidence.title: agent/agent.go
evidence.locator: provider packages claudecode, codex, copilot, opencode, direct, apiprovider
evidence.finding: Provider adapters for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, a direct API runtime and API providers.

evidence.title: agenttik LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT License.

evidence.title: agenttik release v0.7.27
evidence.finding: Assets: Android APK, macOS ARM64 binary, app zip and DMG, Linux amd64 and arm64 binaries, Windows amd64 exe and zip; no iOS build.

evidence.title: agenttik issues
evidence.finding: Public issues; no roadmap or dated announcements found.

evidence.title: Bounded search: worktrees and PRs
evidence.locator: grep -rliE "worktree" app --include=*.go (3 files reading branch and worktree paths: api_branches, api_revert, api_repositories); "gh pr|pull request" (0 files)
evidence.finding: No worktree creation and no pull request features; git support is diff, stage, revert, commit and branches.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry, isolation, SSO, webhooks
evidence.locator: grep -rliE "telemetry|analytics|sentry|posthog" (3 files, all local stats), "docker|container|sandbox" (5: microphone, HTML preview, Codex sandbox flags), "saml|sso|oidc" (0), "webhook" (0) in app
evidence.finding: No telemetry upload, no container or VM runtime of its own (Codex sandbox flags are passed through), no SSO or webhooks.

evidence.title: Agenttik recovery-git
evidence.locator: branchAction; api_integrate.go integrateBranches/finishIntegration; server.go route inventory; LogsPane.vue integration controls
evidence.finding: Local Git supports switch, fetch, fast-forward pull, push, tags, merge/rebase and conflict resolution, with per-repository locks and branch/HEAD checks. Conflict helper guards changes outside conflict paths and checks diff whitespace. No PR integration or deployment API in this pinned route inventory.

evidence.title: Agenttik recovery-runtime
evidence.locator: retryAt/holdForOutage/RunQueueRetries; schedules.go fireSchedule/finishScheduledRun; store/sessions.go ResetRunningSessions; runner.go active map
evidence.finding: Provider outages retry persistently with 30-second capacity delay or exponential one-to-15-minute backoff, provider reset overrides, no retry ceiling. Project queues wait behind oldest retry. Schedule slots skip overlapping open runs, and finite runs or an agent finish marker stop recurrence. Restart marks running turns interrupted; saved transcript and queue remain, not live processes. Active-session and dispatch locks bound duplicate starts, not tool-side exactly-once execution.

evidence.title: Agenttik recovery-direct
evidence.locator: 64-step loop; tools.go codingTools/runTool; agent/apiprovider/provider.go Catalog/config and connection.json
evidence.finding: Direct API turns have 64-step limit, shell/Python 60-second deadline and API HTTP five-minute deadline. Plan mode withholds write tools; shell/Python require full access. File tools use os.OpenRoot; full shell is not sandboxed. API catalog has fixed remote endpoints, no configurable local URL; saved API keys supplement CLI logins.

evidence.title: Agenttik recovery-model
evidence.locator: Project/Session fields; server/api_sessions.go; runner/threads.go inherit/handOver; specs/092-threads.md; server/server.go API inventory
evidence.finding: Tasks are persistent conversations, with flags star/warn/danger, archive, IDs and anchored side threads, not independent issues or epics. Threads can spawn a linked task. Provider/account changes hand over the last 60000 bytes of user/assistant text without tool calls; compatible Claude threads fork native history. Project prompts are copied into session context; modes and files are editable/deletable. No attributed edit ledger, dependency gates or requirement model in these APIs.

evidence.title: Agenttik recovery-data
evidence.locator: uploadAttachment/getAttachment; api_analytics.go; store/analytics.go; server.go routes; specs/011-prompt-bar-usage.md
evidence.finding: Images up to 4 MiB are content-addressed and stored locally with 0600 permissions, referenced in conversation messages. Analytics JSON endpoint aggregates task/model/account usage with distinct reported and estimated cost fields. Provisional usage is replaced by persisted values at turn end. No full workspace export/import endpoint or immutable audit ledger in route inventory.

evidence.title: Agenttik recovery-approval
evidence.locator: allowance/isAllowed/publishResolved; specs/082-tool-approvals.md 145-242; specs/043-exposed-server.md; server/server.go auth routes
evidence.finding: Task grants are in-memory; provider remember modes differ. Default approval timer auto-allows after 30 seconds and chooses the recommended/first question answer; wait/hold alternatives exist. First browser response wins. Exposed listener optionally uses shared password/TOTP, trusted-device revocation and credential-change logout; --web itself does not add login. No named-user RBAC or grant-revoke route in pinned inventory.

evidence.title: Agenttik pinned telemetry source inspection
evidence.locator: Bounded search of app/, web/src/, mobileapp/ (Capacitor shell) and specs/ for telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Segment, Sentry, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Bugsnag, Datadog, Firebase, Crashlytics, gtag and crash reporting, excluding lockfiles, go.sum and node_modules; app/internal/store/analytics.go and web/src/components/AnalyticsPage.vue (local Analytics page); app/internal/update/service.go line 26 (GitHub releases API)
evidence.finding: The Analytics page is a local SQL aggregation of sessions, models and costs served to the user's own interface. No analytics, crash-reporting or usage-upload client exists in the server, web UI or mobile shell. Update checks read the GitHub releases API; other outside hosts are model providers and documentation links.
